snapshot.title: Keep claims and work state consistent across reloads
snapshot.description:
When a reload removes a claimed task, or changes it so it's no longer claimable (e.g. moved out of IN_PROGRESS by a branch switch), end the claim through `endClaim` so pending work state is still recorded once.

Attribute work state that changed only through a hand edit or `git pull` to `ACTOR_TYPE_EXTERNAL`, not to agent `""` (today startup reconciliation records it as an agent with no ID).
